components.name: tf-state
components.reason: Remote state with locking keeps Terraform safe once more than one person or pipeline applies changes (SECURITY.md section 5).

components.name: github-oidc-role
components.sizing: 1 IAM role trusted by GitHub Actions via OIDC
components.reason: CI/CD deploys by assuming a role, so no long-lived AWS keys are stored in GitHub.

components.name: vpc
components.sizing: 2 AZs, public + private subnets, S3 and ECR VPC endpoints
components.reason: Containers and data stores run in private subnets; endpoints avoid NAT data charges for image pulls and S3 traffic.

components.name: ecs-cluster
components.reason: One cluster runs every container service; Fargate means no servers to patch.

components.name: alb
components.reason: One shared load balancer for all web services avoids paying for one per service.

components.name: ecr-apps-api
components.reason: Stores the container image for apps-api.

components.name: ecr-apps-dashboard
components.reason: Stores the container image for apps-dashboard.

components.name: rds-postgres
components.sizing: db.t4g.small, 20 GB gp3, Multi-AZ, backups on
components.reason: postgres is a managed relational database on RDS. One instance serves every service that uses it (give each its own database and user).

components.name: s3-site-apps-docs
components.sizing: private bucket, encryption on, versioning on
components.reason: Holds the built files of apps-docs; only CloudFront can read them.

components.name: s3-site-apps-marketing
components.sizing: private bucket, encryption on, versioning on
components.reason: Holds the built files of apps-marketing; only CloudFront can read them.

components.name: s3-site-apps-spa
components.sizing: private bucket, encryption on, versioning on
components.reason: Holds the built files of apps-spa; only CloudFront can read them.

components.name: cloudfront-apps-docs
components.sizing: 1 distribution, HTTPS only, TLS 1.2+, compression, PriceClass_All
components.reason: apps-docs is a static build: a CDN in front of S3 gives HTTPS, caching and low latency with no servers to run.

components.name: cloudfront-apps-marketing
components.sizing: 1 distribution, HTTPS only, TLS 1.2+, compression, PriceClass_All
components.reason: apps-marketing is a static build: a CDN in front of S3 gives HTTPS, caching and low latency with no servers to run.

components.name: cloudfront-apps-spa
components.sizing: 1 distribution, HTTPS only, TLS 1.2+, compression, PriceClass_All
components.reason: apps-spa is a static build: a CDN in front of S3 gives HTTPS, caching and low latency with no servers to run.

components.name: secrets-apps-api
components.reason: These variables look like credentials or connection strings. Slots are created empty; set values yourself, out of band.

components.name: logs-apps-api
components.reason: CloudWatch logs with an explicit retention so they cannot grow forever.

components.name: logs-apps-dashboard
components.reason: CloudWatch logs with an explicit retention so they cannot grow forever.

components.name: role-apps-api
components.reason: apps-api gets its own role limited to the resources it uses.

components.name: role-apps-dashboard
components.reason: apps-dashboard gets its own role limited to the resources it uses.

components.name: ecs-svc-apps-api
components.reason: Stateless HTTP container behind the shared load balancer.

components.name: ecs-svc-apps-dashboard
components.reason: Stateless HTTP container behind the shared load balancer.

unknowns: Domain name and ACM certificate are needed for HTTPS on the load balancer.
Traffic and data volume are unknown: all sizing is a default starting point.
apps-dashboard: no listening port found; set the container port.
apps-docs: build output directory not detected; assumed dist.
apps-docs: needs a domain (served at apps-docs.<domain_name>) and a CloudFront ACM certificate created in us-east-1, which Terraform does not create.
apps-marketing: needs a domain (served at apps-marketing.<domain_name>) and a CloudFront ACM certificate created in us-east-1, which Terraform does not create.
apps-spa: assumed a single-page app (403/404 answered with /index.html); turn the fallback off for multi-page sites.
apps-spa: needs a domain (served at apps-spa.<domain_name>) and a CloudFront ACM certificate created in us-east-1, which Terraform does not create.
